question: Summarize everything known about the checkout timeout bug: the issue, linked PR, review discussion, and any doc that mentions it.
raw_answer:
The checkout timeout bug was a high-concurrency issue in the Checkout API, resolved by optimizing database connection timeouts in PR #236. PR #326 falsely claimed a fix but only updated documentation.

Context: As of the latest sync. The bug was reported in Issue #44 and closed after PR #236 was merged. Documentation was updated in PR #326 and payments_checkout-README.md.

Reasoning: PR #236 addressed the root cause by optimizing database connection timeouts in payments/checkout.py, as confirmed by reviewer Elena Rostova. PR #326 was excluded as it only updated documentation. The issue was marked closed after PR #236 was approved.

Sources:  
[S1] Issue #44: Checkout timeout during peak load, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/issues/44  
[S2] PR #236: fix(payments): optimize database connection timeouts, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/pull/236  
[S3] PR #326: docs: update checkout documentation, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/pull/326  
[S4] Doc: payments_checkout-README.md, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/blob/main/docs/modules/payments_checkout-README.md
